item_name: Hybrid-SORT (Yang et al., AAAI 2024; arXiv 2308.00783) - weak cues in the association cost as the minimal 'change without the fly' control
depth_level: Short screening (as set in the item). Not a new stand and not a mandatory adoption; the question is only which minimal no-fly control (rule 6.16) must accompany a FlyVis change that enters association. Result: it should NOT move to full analysis as a candidate FlyVis change (it contains no fly node), but its two training-free cues (Tracklet Confidence Modeling, Height-Modulated IoU) should be kept as the named no-fly control family whenever the FlyVis change acts on the matching cost.
bibliography: Mingzhan Yang, Guangxin Han, Bin Yan, Wenhua Zhang, Jinqing Qi, Huchuan Lu, Dong Wang. Hybrid-SORT: Weak Cues Matter for Online Multi-Object Tracking. AAAI 2024, 38(7):6504-6512 (page range as cited in TrackTrack references); arXiv:2308.00783 (v1 1 Aug 2023, revised 20 Jan 2024 - same study). PDF https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.00783 ; code https://github.com/ymzis69/HybridSORT (from memory, not opened) [uncertain]. Project use: BoxMOT 23.0.0 implementation in the tracker zoo (dissertation/ЕДИНЫЙ_ПЛАН.md section 3.6; runs/boxmot_zoo/hybridsort.json for CLEAR/IDF1 values).
full_text_checked: Full arXiv text read (method, Eq. 1-10, Tables 1-8). Code not opened; BoxMOT implementation details not re-checked in this session. Project plan sections 2.x, 3.6 and point 9 on HybridSORT read.
task_and_output: Online tracking-by-detection (SORT family, built on OC-SORT + BYTE second stage + OCR recovery); output: matching of Kalman-predicted tracklets to detections using the cost C = C_HMIoU + lambda1*C_Vel + lambda2*C_Conf (+ lambda3*C_Appr in the ReID variant), solved by Hungarian in three stages.
data_and_independent_videos: DanceTrack (main; ablations on DanceTrack-val), MOT17 (val = half split of train), MOT20; detector YOLOX from OC-SORT, ReID BoT from BoT-SORT. Project: run on BDD100K val (50 videos, older 640 detector, threshold 0.25, no ReID) in the zoo of 08.09.
target_size_and_input_resolution: not applicable (no learned input; uses detector boxes).
frame_rate_and_camera_motion: Native benchmark frame rates; velocity direction computed over intervals of 1-3 frames on four box corners (ROCM); no camera-motion compensation.
detector_and_exemplar: External YOLOX detections; no exemplar; tracklet state = Kalman box extended with confidence and its velocity (TCM); optional EMA ReID appearance.
trainable_nodes_and_loss: None - training-free, hand-designed cues; weights: confidence cost 1.5/1.0 (first/second stage) on DanceTrack, 1.0/1.0 elsewhere; ROCM weight 0.2; IoU rejection threshold 0.15 (DanceTrack) / 0.25 (others).
controls_seeds_splits: Component ablation on DanceTrack-val (Table 4), Kalman vs linear confidence prediction (Table 5), width vs height IoU (Table 6), plug-in to SORT/DeepSORT/MOTDT/ByteTrack on DanceTrack and MOT17 (Tables 7-8). Single runs, no seeds or intervals.

Plan point 9: HybridSORT was not re-run at 960 on full val; the current stand (YOLO26s 960, conf 0.01, XYWHByteTrack + MASA, dev35 HOTA 61.6548 per z13_center_hota_v1) has never been compared with HybridSORT cues.
tested_conditions: Unseen videos: yes (val/test). Target absence: not reported. Similar distractors: yes indirectly (DanceTrack uniform appearance). Occlusion: yes (motivation and DanceTrack/MOT20; no occlusion-sliced metric). Night/low light: not reported. Sequential operation on own predictions: yes (online).
mechanism_summary: Published: weak cues compensate for ambiguous strong cues when boxes overlap - (a) tracklet confidence as an extra Kalman state (or linear extrapolation in the low-score stage), cost |c_trk - c_det|, encoding who is in front during occlusion; (b) Height-IoU multiplied into IoU (height is stable and reflects depth); (c) velocity direction from four corners over 1-3 frame intervals. Proposed use here (not a modification of FlyVis): a fixed, pre-registered subset of these cues (TCM + HMIoU on the first ByteTrack stage) serves as the 'change without the fly' arm whenever a FlyVis change alters association costs; it represents what cheap environment-level cue engineering achieves on the same rows of the cost matrix.
transfer_limits: Cues tuned on pedestrians/dancers; HMIoU hurt slightly on MOT17 for ByteTrack (-0.2) and the width variant hurt strongly, so on BDD100K vehicles (wide boxes, perspective growth) the height assumption is uncertain [uncertain]; our detector runs at conf 0.01, so confidence-state dynamics differ from YOLOX at standard thresholds; the project zoo number (+11.7% HOTA) is from an old setting and includes OC-SORT components (OCM, OCR), not only weak cues. It does not address finding the previous target among similar neighbours inside the eye crop, nor refusal of the fly answer; it acts only on the cost between existing tracks and detections. Implemented on XYWHByteTrack it would be a tracker change (environment), so it cannot be a result of the FlyVis line.
research_questions_addressed: 5.4 only - direct: defines the no-fly control arm for an association-side application of the fly signal. 5.1 caution: confidence state is a cheap 'who is in front' cue that may explain part of any occlusion benefit attributed to the fly. 5.2, 5.3: not applicable.
candidate_node_change: Not applicable as a FlyVis node change. Required role: control arm (2) of rule 6.16 for any FlyVis change that enters the matching cost (for example the additive-hypothesis application from N10): (1) stand; (2) stand + fixed TCM + HMIoU (and separately the Kalman-prior guard from N10) without FlyVis; (3) the FlyVis change on top of (2), not on top of (1). Minimal check before use: replay the stand on train26 with (2) only and record the HOTA shift and the share of lost-track re-captures it changes; stop condition: if (2) alone removes the failure class targeted by the FlyVis change (e.g. the R1 fragmentation pattern), the FlyVis change must be evaluated against (2), and a FlyVis claim requires (3) > (2) with a paired-bootstrap 95% interval above 0.
strongest_objection: Adding Hybrid-SORT cues changes the baseline the project has frozen for dev comparisons (XYWHByteTrack + MASA), and risks turning the study into tracker modernisation; the plan already records that HybridSORT was never re-measured at 960. The control must therefore be a fixed, minimal subset decided before the run, not a tuned tracker.
evidence_strength: Peer-reviewed (AAAI 2024), public code, plug-in gains reported on five trackers, independently reproduced in spirit by the project zoo on BDD100K (old setting) and used as baseline in later work (TrackTrack, MOTIP tables). Single runs, no intervals. Moderate.
where_distinction_is_made: Only in the cost of the association decision (additive terms); no separate presence/refusal decision beyond the IoU rejection threshold; a cost minimum is accepted if below threshold.
feature_dependence: Uses no appearance features in the main variant (only box geometry, score, motion direction) - i.e. exactly the kind of weak signal FlyVis also provides; this is why it is the right no-fly control for small motion/brightness signals.
association_consequence: Directly changes detection-to-track matching; reported -66% ID switches vs ByteTrack in the project zoo (1496 vs 4380, plan section 3.6). An external guard with the same effect is itself; for the R1 case (cost 0.1235 -> 1.0 caused by a centre overwrite) these cues would not help because the IoU term was already zero - the Kalman-prior guard from N10 is the relevant control there.
difference_from_tried: The project tried HybridSORT only as a whole tracker in the zoo (08.09, old detector) and never as a control for FlyVis changes; no z13 card uses confidence-state or height-IoU cues. Difference from z13 experiments: complete - it is not a FlyVis change at all, which is why it can only be a control.
memory_write_policy: not applicable (no memory beyond Kalman/confidence state and EMA appearance in the ReID variant).
distractor_representation: Implicit: neighbouring tracklets compete in the Hungarian cost; confidence state encodes occluder vs occluded.
refusal_evidence_horizon: Single frame threshold on cost (IoU rejection 0.15/0.25); confidence state integrates over frames via Kalman.
association_entry_point: Matching cost (additive weak-cue terms in all three stages).
no_fly_control_equivalent: It is itself the no-fly control: fixed TCM + HMIoU added to the first ByteTrack stage, plus the Kalman-prior guard (no correction when the uncorrected prior already matches below 0.8) from N10. Kalman motion gating and an IoU check are the other cheap equivalents.
hard_subset_evaluation: No within-dataset hard subset; DanceTrack used as the hard benchmark by design (uniform appearance, nonlinear motion).
temporal_information_availability: Only current and past frames (online, zero latency); linear confidence prediction uses the last two tracklet confidences.
